text:
Kai: Hey team — I’m on my first feature PR (branch: feat/kai/quick-routing). CI is failing on pre-commit lint. Also not sure about branch naming, commit message format, and who should review/merge. Any quick checklist for first-week PRs? :wave:

devex-bot: Hi Kai! We have a short PR checklist: https://redwood.dev/devex/pr-checklist. Quick commands to try locally: `./scripts/setup && pre-commit run --all-files`. Also check CI statuses before requesting review.

Olivia: :wave: Welcome! Branching: use `feat/` or `fix/` plus your initials or ticket number — `feat/kai/…` or `feat/1234-add-route` both fine. Commit messages follow Conventional Commits: `feat(core): short summary` or `fix(api): ...`. Try to keep PRs small (prefer < 300 LOC). If it's larger, add a short design summary in the description.

Jess: For reviewers, tag one owner from CODEOWNERS and one teammate familiar with the area. Infra/runtime -> ping @Mira, UI -> ping @Jess. If you're unsure, mention `@Olivia` for a quick triage.

Mira: Common CI failures are formatting (black/ruff) or type errors. Locally run:
```
poetry run ruff check .
poetry run ruff --fix .
poetry run black --check .
```
If tests fail, run `pytest path/to/test` to reproduce. If a lint rule is noisy, open a short comment in PR and we can decide whether to relax it or fix.

Kai: Thanks — quick Q: do we squash on merge or keep commits? Also how many approvals are required?

Olivia: We use "Squash and merge" for feature branches. Required approvals: 1 reviewer + green CI for most dirs. Protected areas (e.g., infra/, runtime/) require 2 approvers. CODEOWNERS approvals are enforced by the branch protection rules.

Jess: Add a brief manual test plan in the PR template if the change touches public behavior: steps, expected output, any env vars. Also link the ticket/issue number in the PR title (e.g., "1234: add routing fallback").

ci-bot: CI | Build #4321 — Lint failed on 3 files (ruff). Logs: https://ci.redwood/build/4321

Mira: If you paste the lint output I can point to quick fixes. `ruff --fix` usually resolves most. For mypy errors, paste the snippet and we can pair for typing details.

Kai: Pasted the errors in the PR comment — ran `ruff --fix` and fixed most. One remaining mypy error about a TypedDict shape; I’ll DM Mira to pair for 15m. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
